talents.name: Deflection
talents.description: Increases your Parry chance by 1/2/3/4/5% (per rank).

talents.name: Benediction
talents.description: Reduces the Mana cost of all instant-cast spells and abilities by 2/4/6/8/10% (per rank).

talents.name: Improved Judgement
talents.description: Reduces the cooldown of Judgement by 1/2 sec. Requires 5 points.

talents.name: Holy Conduit
talents.description: Reduces the Mana cost of Consecration, Holy Wrath, Exorcism and Hammer of Wrath by 20/40%. Requires 5 points.

talents.name: Conviction
talents.description: Improves your chance to critically strike with melee attacks by 1/2/3/4/5% (per rank). Requires 5 points.

talents.name: Vindication
talents.description: Damaging melee attacks can reduce the target's Attack Power by 42/84/126 and raise yours by 1/2/3% for 30 sec. Requires 10 points.

talents.name: Sanctified Judgement
talents.description: Judgement has a 33/66/100% chance to refund 20/40/60% of the judged Seal's Mana cost. Unlocks Vengeance. Requires 10 points.

talents.name: Seal of Command
talents.description: 65 Mana, Instant. Chance to deal bonus Holy damage equal to 70% of weapon damage; judging strikes for 48.5 Holy (97 vs stunned/incapacitated). 30 sec, one Seal at a time. Requires 10 points.

talents.name: Pursuit of Justice
talents.description: Increases movement and mounted speed by 8/15% (does not stack with other speed effects). Requires 10 points.

talents.name: Eye for an Eye
talents.description: Critical strikes against you also deal 5/10% of the damage taken to the attacker (capped at 50% of your health). Requires 15 points.

talents.name: Sacred Arbiter
talents.description: Increases Holy Strike damage by 20% and makes it refresh all Judgement effects on the target. Requires 15 points.

talents.name: Two-Handed Weapon Specialization
talents.description: Increases damage with two-handed melee weapons by 2/4/6%. Requires 20 points.

talents.name: Vengeance
talents.description: Non-periodic critical strikes increase your Physical and Holy damage by 1/2/3% for 30 sec, stacking up to 3 times. Requires Sanctified Judgement maxed + 20 points.

talents.name: Repentance
talents.description: 60 Mana, 20 yd range, Instant, 1 min cooldown. Puts a Humanoid target in meditation, incapacitating it for up to 6 sec (damage breaks it). Gold talent (~21 pts). Requires 20 points.

talents.name: Champion of the Light
talents.description: Increases spell damage and healing by up to 33/66/100% of your Intellect. Requires 25 points.

talents.name: Instrument of Law
talents.description: Reduces Hammer of Wrath cast time by 0.5/1.0 sec and all threat generated by 10/20% while Righteous Fury is off. Requires 25 points.

talents.name: Twist of Light
talents.description: Seal spells cost 20% less Mana; replacing Seal of Command, Righteousness, Fury or Justice grants an Echo of it, applied by your next melee attack. Capstone (~31 pts). Requires 30 points.
